A Chinese-language query gave only unreliable alumni lists. The Duke FinTech MEng started in 2019, so its graduates fail the 2018 cutoff; its advisory board (Logan Allin known, Christina Qi, Craig Messinger, Kate Sampson known) gave no new qualifying names. duke.edu pages are blocked by the proxy. Worth one more search each: Aaron Patzer and Jason Robins (Duke-confirmed angels missing only a 2025-26 dated deal), Max Hodak (Duke BME, Science Corp), Cassie Kozyrkov (Duke graduate degrees per memory, unsearched), and Mischief fund's current deals for Perret.
